# Bundled dependencies

- chess.js 1.4.0: https://github.com/jhlywa/chess.js/tree/v1.4.0 — BSD-2-Clause, license included. The published CommonJS distribution is wrapped for browser and Node use without changing the rules.
- Stockfish.js 19.0.0, lite single-thread: https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js — GPL-3.0, license included. Exact npm package: https://registry.npmjs.org/stockfish/-/stockfish-19.0.0.tgz. Source/build instructions: https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js . Binary assets are unchanged.

Serve this directory over localhost HTTP for WASM/worker support. No player answers are sent to an external service.
